name: Queue Horn
summary: Hear and see it the moment your dungeon group, ready check, battleground or pet battle pops, even while you are tabbed out.
logoPrompt: A curved brass hunting horn with a polished glowing rim, lying slightly tilted in the centre, with soft rings of sound rising from its bell

cover.tagline: Never miss a queue pop again.

description: **Queue Horn makes sure you notice when your group is ready, even when you are tabbed out or the game sound is turned down.**
- Alerts when the Dungeon Finder or Raid Finder has a group for you.
- Alerts on a ready check someone else starts, and when a battleground, arena or pet battle match is ready.
- One sound on the Master channel, a flashing game icon in your taskbar or dock and a short message in the middle of the screen.
- Each alert and the icon flash can be switched off.
Install it and queue up. `/qh` (or `/queuehorn`) shows the settings, `/qh test` plays the alert once. `/qh lfg off` switches one alert off, the others are `ready`, `pvp` and `pet`.
- Works on Retail. No combat data and no window.
- The same alert never plays twice within 5 seconds.
- To hear it while tabbed out, keep Sound in Background on in the game's sound options.
- Settings are shared by all your characters.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
